# Craftax source trajectories

`<Wrapper>-<case>.npz` holds arrays recorded from the pinned stable-worldmodel Craftax wrappers.
`tests/helpers/reference/craftax_source.py` loads them as the source side of the checks in
`tests/unit/test_craftax_rendering.py` and `tests/unit/test_craftax_semantics.py`.
`SHA256SUMS` lists the hash of each file.
